  constraint nmi_history_months_category_check CHECK ((category = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'card_data'::text, 'issuer_soft'::text, 'issuer_hard'::text, 'gateway_rule'::text, 'system_error'::text, 'unknown'::text])))
  constraint nmi_history_months_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['verification'::text, 'one_off_sale'::text, 'scheduled_rebill'::text])))
  constraint nmi_history_months_month_at_check CHECK ((month_at = date_trunc('month'::text, month_at, 'UTC'::text)))
  constraint nmi_history_months_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, month_at, kind, category, reason)
  constraint nmi_history_months_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint nmi_history_months_reason_check CHECK (((category = 'approved'::text) = (reason = ''::text)))
  index CREATE INDEX nmi_history_months_month_at_idx ON billing.nmi_history_months USING btree (merchant_id, month_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nmi_history_months_pkey ON billing.nmi_history_months USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, month_at, kind, category, reason)

table billing.nmi_history_reads
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column read_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  constraint nmi_history_reads_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, psp_id)
  constraint nmi_history_reads_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nmi_history_reads_pkey ON billing.nmi_history_reads USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id)

table billing.notifications
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column event_type text NOT NULL
  column data jsonb NOT NULL
  column recipient_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'customer'::text
  column read_at timestamp with time zone
  column severity text
  column title text
  column body text
  column link text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid
  column emailed_at timestamp with time zone
  constraint notifications_body_check CHECK ((body <> ''::text))
  constraint notifications_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint notifications_link_check CHECK ((link <> ''::text))
  constraint notifications_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint notifications_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint notifications_recipient_check CHECK ((((recipient_kind = 'customer'::text) AND (customer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (severity IS NULL) AND (title IS NULL) AND (body IS NULL) AND (link IS NULL)) OR ((recipient_kind = 'merchant'::text) AND (customer_id IS NULL) AND (event_type = 'operator.alert'::text) AND (emailed_at IS NULL) AND (severity IS NOT NULL) AND (title IS NOT NULL) AND (body IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint notifications_severity_check CHECK ((severity <> ''::text))
  constraint notifications_title_check CHECK ((title <> ''::text))
  index CREATE INDEX notifications_created_at_id_idx ON billing.notifications USING btree (merchant_id, created_at, id) WHERE ((recipient_kind = 'customer'::text) AND (emailed_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX notifications_created_at_idx ON billing.notifications USING btree (merchant_id, created_at)
  index CREATE INDEX notifications_customer_id_idx ON billing.notifications USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id) WHERE (customer_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX notifications_event_type_idx ON billing.notifications USING btree (event_type)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX notifications_pkey ON billing.notifications USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX notifications_recipient_kind_customer_id_read_at_created_at_idx ON billing.notifications USING btree (merchant_id, recipient_kind, customer_id, read_at, created_at DESC)

table billing.operation_authorization_extensions
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column operation_id text NOT NULL
  column ordinal bigint NOT NULL
  column requested_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column minimum_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column granted_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column authorized_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint operation_authorization_extensions_amounts_check CHECK (((minimum_amount > 0) AND (minimum_amount <= granted_amount) AND (granted_amount <= requested_amount)))
  constraint operation_authorization_extensions_authorization_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, operation_id) REFERENCES billing.operation_authorizations(merchant_id, operation_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint operation_authorization_extensions_authorized_check CHECK ((authorized_amount > granted_amount))
  constraint operation_authorization_extensions_ordinal_check CHECK ((ordinal >= 1))
  constraint operation_authorization_extensions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, operation_id, ordinal)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX operation_authorization_extensions_pkey ON billing.operation_authorization_extensions USING btree (merchant_id, operation_id, ordinal)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_operation_authorization_extensions BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.operation_authorization_extensions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()

table billing.operation_authorizations
  column operation_id text NOT NULL
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column record_owner text NOT NULL
  column ledger_account_id uuid NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column amount bigint NOT NULL
  column claim_reference text NOT NULL
  column authorization_body_bytes bytea NOT NULL
  column authorization_body_digest bytea NOT NULL
  column state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'::text
  column terminal_reference text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column released_at timestamp with time zone
  column settled_at timestamp with time zone
  column settlement_cost_amount bigint
  column settlement_amount bigint
  column settlement_body_bytes bytea
  column settlement_body_digest bytea
  column extended_amount bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column authorized_amount bigint NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((amount + extended_amount)) STORED
  constraint operation_authorizations_amount_positive_check CHECK ((amount > 0))
  constraint operation_authorizations_body_present_check CHECK ((octet_length(authorization_body_bytes) > 0))
  constraint operation_authorizations_body_size_check CHECK ((octet_length(authorization_body_bytes) <= 65536))
  constraint operation_authorizations_claim_reference_present_check CHECK (((claim_reference <> ''::text) AND (claim_reference = btrim(claim_reference))))
  constraint operation_authorizations_claim_reference_size_check CHECK ((octet_length(claim_reference) <= 1024))
  constraint operation_authorizations_currency_check CHECK ((currency = 'USD'::text))
  constraint operation_authorizations_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint operation_authorizations_digest_check CHECK ((octet_length(authorization_body_digest) = 32))
  constraint operation_authorizations_digest_matches_body_check CHECK ((authorization_body_digest = sha256(authorization_body_bytes)))
  constraint operation_authorizations_extended_amount_check CHECK ((extended_amount >= 0))
  constraint operation_authorizations_ledger_account_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, ledger_account_id) REFERENCES billing.ledger_accounts(merchant_id, customer_id, currency, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint operation_authorizations_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint operation_authorizations_operation_id_present_check CHECK (((operation_id <> ''::text) AND (operation_id = btrim(operation_id))))
  constraint operation_authorizations_operation_id_size_check CHECK ((octet_length(operation_id) <= 255))
  constraint operation_authorizations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, operation_id)
  constraint operation_authorizations_record_owner_present_check CHECK (((record_owner <> ''::text) AND (record_owner = btrim(record_owner))))
  constraint operation_authorizations_record_owner_size_check CHECK ((octet_length(record_owner) <= 255))
  constraint operation_authorizations_settlement_check CHECK ((((state <> 'settled'::text) AND (settlement_cost_amount IS NULL) AND (settlement_amount IS NULL) AND (settlement_body_bytes IS NULL) AND (settlement_body_digest IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'settled'::text) AND (settlement_cost_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (settlement_cost_amount >= 0) AND (settlement_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (settlement_amount >= 0) AND (settlement_amount = settlement_cost_amount) AND (settlement_body_bytes IS NOT NULL) AND ((octet_length(settlement_body_bytes) >= 1) AND (octet_length(settlement_body_bytes) <= 65536)) AND (settlement_body_digest IS NOT NULL) AND (octet_length(settlement_body_digest) = 32) AND (settlement_body_digest = sha256(settlement_body_bytes)) AND (terminal_reference = ('sha256:'::text || encode(settlement_body_digest, 'hex'::text))))))
  constraint operation_authorizations_state_check CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'released'::text, 'settled'::text])))
  constraint operation_authorizations_terminal_check CHECK ((((state = 'open'::text) AND (terminal_reference IS NULL) AND (released_at IS NULL) AND (settled_at IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'released'::text) AND (terminal_reference <> ''::text) AND (released_at IS NOT NULL) AND (settled_at IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'settled'::text) AND (terminal_reference <> ''::text) AND (released_at IS NULL) AND (settled_at IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint operation_authorizations_terminal_reference_size_check CHECK (((terminal_reference IS NULL) OR (octet_length(terminal_reference) <= 1024)))
  index CREATE INDEX operation_authorizations_customer_id_created_at_idx ON billing.operation_authorizations USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, created_at DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX operation_authorizations_customer_id_currency_idx ON billing.operation_authorizations USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency) WHERE (state = 'open'::text)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX operation_authorizations_pkey ON billing.operation_authorizations USING btree (merchant_id, operation_id)
  index CREATE INDEX operation_authorizations_state_created_at_idx ON billing.operation_authorizations USING btree (merchant_id, state, created_at DESC, operation_id DESC)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_operation_authorization_facts BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.operation_authorizations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_billing_fact_columns('state', 'terminal_reference', 'released_at', 'settled_at', 'settlement_cost_amount', 'settlement_amount', 'settlement_body_bytes', 'settlement_body_digest', 'extended_amount', 'authorized_amount')

table billing.order_lines
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column order_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column "position" integer NOT NULL
  column price_id uuid NOT NULL
  column product_id uuid NOT NULL
  column description text NOT NULL
  column quantity integer
  column unit_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column amount bigint NOT NULL
  column ownership text NOT NULL
  column claim_key text
  column billing_interval_hours integer
  column access_duration_hours integer
  column credit_grant jsonb
  column subscription_id uuid
  column product_access_id uuid
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint order_lines_access_duration_hours_check CHECK ((access_duration_hours > 0))
  constraint order_lines_amount_check CHECK (((unit_amount >= 0) AND (amount = (unit_amount * COALESCE(quantity, 1)))))
  constraint order_lines_billing_interval_hours_check CHECK ((billing_interval_hours > 0))
  constraint order_lines_claim_key_check CHECK (((claim_key IS NOT NULL) = (ownership = 'unique'::text)))
  constraint order_lines_description_check CHECK ((description <> ''::text))
  constraint order_lines_order_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, order_id) REFERENCES billing.orders(merchant_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint order_lines_order_id_position_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, order_id, "position")
  constraint order_lines_ownership_check CHECK ((ownership = ANY (ARRAY['unique'::text, 'consumable'::text, 'extend'::text])))
  constraint order_lines_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint order_lines_position_check CHECK ((("position" >= 0) AND ("position" < 100)))
  constraint order_lines_price_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, price_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id)
  constraint order_lines_product_access_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, product_access_id) REFERENCES billing.product_access(merchant_id, id)
  constraint order_lines_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, product_id) REFERENCES billing.products(merchant_id, id)
  constraint order_lines_quantified_check CHECK (((quantity IS NOT NULL) OR (billing_interval_hours IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint order_lines_quantity_check CHECK ((quantity >= 1))
  constraint order_lines_seats_check CHECK (((quantity IS NULL) OR (quantity = 1) OR (ownership = 'consumable'::text) OR (billing_interval_hours IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint order_lines_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_lines_order_id_position_key ON billing.order_lines USING btree (merchant_id, order_id, "position")
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_lines_pkey ON billing.order_lines USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX order_lines_price_id_idx ON billing.order_lines USING btree (merchant_id, price_id)
  index CREATE INDEX order_lines_subscription_id_idx ON billing.order_lines USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE (subscription_id IS NOT NULL)

table billing.orders
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column origin text NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column total bigint NOT NULL
  column number text
  column idempotency_key text
  column request_digest bytea
  column payment_method_id uuid
  column psp_id uuid
  column attempt_id uuid
  column payment_id uuid
  column last_payment_error jsonb
  column expires_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column paid_at timestamp with time zone
  column canceled_at timestamp with time zone
  column expired_at timestamp with time zone
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint orders_attempt_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, attempt_id) REFERENCES billing.checkout_attempts(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (attempt_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
  constraint orders_canceled_check CHECK (((status <> 'canceled'::text) OR (canceled_at IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint orders_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint orders_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint orders_customer_id_id_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  constraint orders_expired_check CHECK (((status <> 'expired'::text) OR (expired_at IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint orders_idempotency_key_check CHECK (((octet_length(idempotency_key) >= 1) AND (octet_length(idempotency_key) <= 512)))
  constraint orders_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint orders_number_check CHECK ((number <> ''::text))
  constraint orders_origin_check CHECK ((origin = ANY (ARRAY['customer'::text, 'merchant'::text])))
  constraint orders_paid_check CHECK (((status = 'paid'::text) = ((number IS NOT NULL) AND (paid_at IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint orders_paid_payment_check CHECK (((status <> 'paid'::text) OR (total = 0) OR (payment_id IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint orders_payment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, payment_id) REFERENCES billing.payments(merchant_id, customer_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
  constraint orders_payment_method_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, payment_method_id) REFERENCES billing.payment_methods(merchant_id, id)
  constraint orders_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint orders_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id)
  constraint orders_request_digest_check CHECK ((((idempotency_key IS NULL) = (request_digest IS NULL)) AND ((request_digest IS NULL) OR (octet_length(request_digest) = 32))))
  constraint orders_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'requires_action'::text, 'processing'::text, 'paid'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'expired'::text])))
  constraint orders_total_check CHECK ((total >= 0))
  index CREATE INDEX orders_closed_at_unpaid_idx ON billing.orders USING btree (merchant_id, COALESCE(canceled_at, expired_at)) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['canceled'::text, 'expired'::text])) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX orders_created_at_id_idx ON billing.orders USING btree (merchant_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX orders_customer_id_created_at_id_idx ON billing.orders USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_customer_id_id_key ON billing.orders USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX orders_expires_at_live_idx ON billing.orders USING btree (merchant_id, expires_at) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'requires_action'::text]))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_idempotency_key_key ON billing.orders USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, idempotency_key) WHERE (idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_number_key ON billing.orders USING btree (merchant_id, number) WHERE (number IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX orders_payment_method_id_idx ON billing.orders USING btree (merchant_id, payment_method_id) WHERE (payment_method_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON billing.orders USING btree (merchant_id, id)

table billing.ownership_claims
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column claim_key text NOT NULL
  column order_id uuid NOT NULL
  column holder_type text NOT NULL
  column holder_id uuid NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint ownership_claims_claim_key_check CHECK ((claim_key ~ '^(product|tier_group):.+$'::text))
  constraint ownership_claims_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint ownership_claims_holder_check CHECK (((holder_type <> 'order'::text) OR (holder_id = order_id)))
  constraint ownership_claims_holder_type_check CHECK ((holder_type = ANY (ARRAY['order'::text, 'subscription'::text, 'product_access'::text])))
  constraint ownership_claims_order_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, order_id) REFERENCES billing.orders(merchant_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint ownership_claims_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, claim_key)
  index CREATE INDEX ownership_claims_holder_idx ON billing.ownership_claims USING btree (merchant_id, holder_type, holder_id)
  index CREATE INDEX ownership_claims_order_id_idx ON billing.ownership_claims USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, order_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ownership_claims_pkey ON billing.ownership_claims USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, claim_key)

table billing.payment_attempts
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column kind text NOT NULL
  column owner text NOT NULL
  column card_entry text NOT NULL
  column source text NOT NULL
  column observed_via text NOT NULL
  column category text NOT NULL
  column reason text
  column action text
  column response_code text
  column response_text text
  column transaction_id text
  column avs_result text
  column cvv_result text
  column card_brand text
  column card_last4 text
  column token_type text
  column amount bigint NOT NULL
  column currency text
  column attempted_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column checkout_id uuid
  column checkout_target text
  column subscription_id uuid
  column payment_method_id uuid
  column payment_id uuid
  column provider_intent_id uuid
  column step text NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column cycle_id uuid
  column card_bin text
  column issuer_code text
  column issuer_text text
  column enriched_at timestamp with time zone
  column mandate_id uuid
  column sent_initial_transaction_id text
  column invoice_id uuid
  column order_id uuid
  constraint payment_attempts_action_check CHECK (((action IS NULL) OR (action = ANY (ARRAY['retry'::text, 'fix_payment_method'::text, 'non_recoverable'::text]))))
  constraint payment_attempts_amount_check CHECK ((amount >= 0))
  constraint payment_attempts_card_bin_check CHECK ((card_bin ~ '^[0-9]{6,8}$'::text))
  constraint payment_attempts_card_entry_check CHECK ((card_entry = ANY (ARRAY['new'::text, 'saved'::text])))
  constraint payment_attempts_category_check CHECK ((category = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'card_data'::text, 'issuer_soft'::text, 'issuer_hard'::text, 'gateway_rule'::text, 'system_error'::text, 'unknown'::text])))
  constraint payment_attempts_checkout_check CHECK (((checkout_id IS NULL) = (checkout_target IS NULL)))
  constraint payment_attempts_currency_check CHECK (((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text) OR ((currency IS NULL) AND (amount = 0))))
  constraint payment_attempts_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint payment_attempts_cycle_check CHECK (((kind = ANY (ARRAY['rebill'::text, 'dunning_retry'::text, 'customer_retry'::text])) = (cycle_id IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint payment_attempts_cycle_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, cycle_id) REFERENCES billing.rebill_cycles(merchant_id, id)
  constraint payment_attempts_invoice_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, invoice_id) REFERENCES billing.invoices(merchant_id, id)
  constraint payment_attempts_issuer_check CHECK (((length(issuer_code) <= 32) AND (length(issuer_text) <= 128)))
  constraint payment_attempts_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['verify'::text, 'initial'::text, 'upgrade'::text, 'rebill'::text, 'dunning_retry'::text, 'customer_retry'::text, 'invoice'::text])))
  constraint payment_attempts_last4_check CHECK ((card_last4 ~ '^[0-9]{4}$'::text))
  constraint payment_attempts_mandate_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, mandate_id) REFERENCES billing.mandates(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (mandate_id)
  constraint payment_attempts_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint payment_attempts_observed_via_check CHECK ((observed_via = ANY (ARRAY['response'::text, 'webhook'::text, 'pull'::text])))
  constraint payment_attempts_order_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, order_id) REFERENCES billing.orders(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (order_id)
  constraint payment_attempts_outcome_check CHECK (((category = 'approved'::text) = ((reason IS NULL) AND (action IS NULL))))
  constraint payment_attempts_owner_check CHECK ((owner = ANY (ARRAY['engine'::text, 'nmi_schedule'::text, 'provider'::text, 'none'::text])))
  constraint payment_attempts_payable_check CHECK (((invoice_id IS NULL) OR (order_id IS NULL)))
  constraint payment_attempts_payment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, payment_id) REFERENCES billing.payments(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (payment_id)
  constraint payment_attempts_payment_method_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, payment_method_id) REFERENCES billing.payment_methods(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (payment_method_id)
  constraint payment_attempts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint payment_attempts_provider_intent_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, provider_intent_id) REFERENCES billing.provider_intents(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (provider_intent_id)
  constraint payment_attempts_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint payment_attempts_sent_initial_transaction_id_check CHECK ((sent_initial_transaction_id <> ''::text))
  constraint payment_attempts_source_check CHECK ((source = ANY (ARRAY['openrails'::text, 'provider_schedule'::text, 'external'::text])))
  constraint payment_attempts_text_check CHECK ((length(response_text) <= 128))
  constraint payment_attempts_token_type_check CHECK ((token_type = ANY (ARRAY['network_token'::text, 'pan_via_proxy'::text, 'psp_token'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX payment_attempts_attempted_at_time_idx ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, attempted_at)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_attempts_attempted_at_unenriched_idx ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, attempted_at) WHERE ((enriched_at IS NULL) AND (rail = 'nmi'::text) AND (transaction_id IS NOT NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX payment_attempts_checkout_id_attempted_at_idx ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, checkout_id, attempted_at) WHERE (checkout_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_attempts_customer_id_checkout_target_attempted_at_idx ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, checkout_target, attempted_at) WHERE (checkout_target IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_attempts_cycle_id_idx ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, cycle_id) WHERE (cycle_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_attempts_invoice_id_attempted_at_idx ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, invoice_id, attempted_at) WHERE (invoice_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_attempts_order_id_attempted_at_idx ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, order_id, attempted_at) WHERE (order_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_attempts_payment_id_idx ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, payment_id) WHERE (payment_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_attempts_payment_method_id_idx ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, payment_method_id) WHERE (payment_method_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_attempts_pkey ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_attempts_provider_intent_id_step_key ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, provider_intent_id, step) WHERE (provider_intent_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_attempts_psp_id_transaction_id_key ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, transaction_id) WHERE (transaction_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_attempts_subscription_id_attempted_at_idx ON billing.payment_attempts USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, attempted_at) WHERE (subscription_id IS NOT NULL)

table billing.payment_method_updates
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column payment_method_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid
  column source text NOT NULL
  column kind text NOT NULL
  column event_ref text NOT NULL
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint payment_method_updates_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint payment_method_updates_event_ref_check CHECK ((event_ref <> ''::text))
  constraint payment_method_updates_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['updated'::text, 'brand_changed'::text, 'closed_account'::text, 'contact_customer'::text])))
  constraint payment_method_updates_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint payment_method_updates_payment_method_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, payment_method_id) REFERENCES billing.payment_methods(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint payment_method_updates_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint payment_method_updates_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint payment_method_updates_source_check CHECK ((source = ANY (ARRAY['nmi_acu'::text, 'bt_account_updater'::text, 'stripe_card_updater'::text, 'customer'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX payment_method_updates_customer_id_idx ON billing.payment_method_updates USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_method_updates_payment_method_id_occurred_at_idx ON billing.payment_method_updates USING btree (merchant_id, payment_method_id, occurred_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_method_updates_pkey ON billing.payment_method_updates USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_method_updates_psp_id_idx ON billing.payment_method_updates USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_method_updates_source_event_ref_payment_method_id_key ON billing.payment_method_updates USING btree (merchant_id, source, event_ref, payment_method_id)

table billing.payment_methods
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid
  column custodian text NOT NULL
  column custodian_id uuid
  column rail_customer_ref text
  column rail_method_ref text
  column card_brand text
  column card_last4 text
  column card_exp_month smallint
  column card_exp_year smallint
  column metadata jsonb
  column fingerprint text
  column network_token_id text
  column network_token_status text
  column network_token_par text
  column charge_via text NOT NULL
  column park_reason text
  column parked_at timestamp with time zone
  column account_updater_checked_at timestamp with time zone
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint payment_methods_card_exp_month_check CHECK (((card_exp_month >= 1) AND (card_exp_month <= 12)))
  constraint payment_methods_card_exp_year_check CHECK (((card_exp_year >= 2000) AND (card_exp_year <= 2199)))
  constraint payment_methods_card_expiry_pair_check CHECK (((card_exp_month IS NULL) = (card_exp_year IS NULL)))
  constraint payment_methods_card_last4_check CHECK ((card_last4 ~ '^[0-9]{4}$'::text))
  constraint payment_methods_charge_via_check CHECK ((charge_via = ANY (ARRAY['pan_proxy'::text, 'network_token'::text])))
  constraint payment_methods_custodian_check CHECK ((custodian = ANY (ARRAY['psp'::text, 'basis_theory'::text, 'hyperswitch'::text])))
  constraint payment_methods_custodian_id_custodian_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, custodian_id, custodian) REFERENCES billing.custodians(merchant_id, id, kind) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint payment_methods_custodian_identity_check CHECK (((custodian = 'psp'::text) = (custodian_id IS NULL)))
  constraint payment_methods_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint payment_methods_customer_id_id_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  constraint payment_methods_fingerprint_check CHECK ((fingerprint <> ''::text))
  constraint payment_methods_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint payment_methods_network_token_id_check CHECK ((network_token_id <> ''::text))
  constraint payment_methods_network_token_par_check CHECK ((network_token_par <> ''::text))
  constraint payment_methods_network_token_status_check CHECK ((network_token_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'inactive'::text, 'suspended'::text, 'deleted'::text])))
  constraint payment_methods_park_reason_check CHECK ((park_reason <> ''::text))
  constraint payment_methods_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint payment_methods_psp_custody_check CHECK (((custodian = 'psp'::text) = (psp_id IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint payment_methods_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint payment_methods_rail_customer_ref_check CHECK ((rail_customer_ref <> ''::text))
  constraint payment_methods_rail_method_ref_check CHECK ((rail_method_ref <> ''::text))
  index CREATE INDEX payment_methods_custodian_account_updater_checked_at_idx ON billing.payment_methods USING btree (merchant_id, custodian, account_updater_checked_at NULLS FIRST) WHERE ((custodian <> 'psp'::text) AND (rail_method_ref IS NOT NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX payment_methods_custodian_id_network_token_id_idx ON billing.payment_methods USING btree (merchant_id, custodian_id, network_token_id) WHERE ((custodian <> 'psp'::text) AND (network_token_id IS NOT NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX payment_methods_custodian_id_rail_method_ref_idx ON billing.payment_methods USING btree (merchant_id, custodian_id, rail_method_ref) WHERE (custodian <> 'psp'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_methods_customer_id_created_at_id_idx ON billing.payment_methods USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_methods_customer_id_id_key ON billing.payment_methods USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_methods_fingerprint_idx ON billing.payment_methods USING btree (merchant_id, fingerprint) WHERE (fingerprint IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_methods_pkey ON billing.payment_methods USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX payment_methods_psp_id_idx ON billing.payment_methods USING btree (psp_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_methods_psp_instrument_key ON billing.payment_methods USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, custodian_id, rail_customer_ref, rail_method_ref) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
  index CREATE INDEX payment_methods_rail_rail_method_ref_idx ON billing.payment_methods USING btree (rail, rail_method_ref)

table billing.payments
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column price_id uuid
  column channel text NOT NULL
  column rail text
  column transaction_id text NOT NULL
  column amount bigint NOT NULL
  column list_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column subscription_id uuid
  column refunded_payment_id uuid
  column discount_code text
  column discount_reason text
  column discount_metadata jsonb
  column metadata jsonb
  column purchased_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column card_brand text
  column card_last4 text
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid
  column attempt_kind text
  column failure_code text
  column failure_reason text
  column reversal_kind text
  column token_type text
  column deleted_at timestamp with time zone
  column destructive_run_id uuid
  column destructive_run_class text GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE WHEN (destructive_run_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'destructive'::text ELSE NULL::text END) STORED
  column money_movement text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none'::text
  column credit_grant_snapshot jsonb
  column order_id uuid
  column invoice_id uuid
  column ledger_transfer_id uuid
  column quantity integer
  constraint payments_attempt_kind_check CHECK (((attempt_kind IS NULL) OR (attempt_kind = ANY (ARRAY['initial'::text, 'renewal'::text]))))
  constraint payments_channel_check CHECK ((channel = ANY (ARRAY['rail'::text, 'manual'::text])))
  constraint payments_channel_psp_check CHECK ( CASE WHEN (channel = 'rail'::text) THEN ((rail IS NOT NULL) AND (psp_id IS NOT NULL)) ELSE ((rail IS NULL) AND (psp_id IS NULL)) END)
  constraint payments_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint payments_customer_id_currency_id_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, id)
  constraint payments_customer_id_currency_refunded_payment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, refunded_payment_id) REFERENCES billing.payments(merchant_id, customer_id, currency, id)
  constraint payments_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint payments_customer_id_id_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  constraint payments_customer_id_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (subscription_id)
  constraint payments_destructive_run_id_destructive_run_class_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, destructive_run_id, destructive_run_class) REFERENCES billing.maintenance_runs(merchant_id, id, run_class) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint payments_invoice_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, invoice_id) REFERENCES billing.invoices(merchant_id, customer_id, currency, id)
  constraint payments_invoice_ledger_check CHECK ( CASE WHEN (refunded_payment_id IS NULL) THEN ((invoice_id IS NULL) = (ledger_transfer_id IS NULL)) ELSE (ledger_transfer_id IS NULL) END)
  constraint payments_ledger_transfer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, ledger_transfer_id) REFERENCES billing.ledger_transfers(merchant_id, customer_id, currency, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
  constraint payments_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint payments_money_movement_check CHECK ((money_movement = ANY (ARRAY['rail'::text, 'none'::text])))
  constraint payments_not_future_check CHECK ((purchased_at <= (now() + '00:05:00'::interval)))
  constraint payments_order_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, order_id) REFERENCES billing.orders(merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  constraint payments_payable_check CHECK ((num_nonnulls(order_id, invoice_id, price_id) = 1))
  constraint payments_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint payments_price_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, price_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id)
  constraint payments_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint payments_quantity_check CHECK (((quantity IS NULL) OR ((quantity >= 1) AND (subscription_id IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint payments_reversal_check CHECK (((reversal_kind IS NULL) = (refunded_payment_id IS NULL)))
  constraint payments_reversal_kind_check CHECK (((reversal_kind IS NULL) OR (reversal_kind = ANY (ARRAY['refund'::text, 'chargeback'::text, 'dispute_reversal'::text]))))
  constraint payments_sign_check CHECK ( CASE WHEN ((reversal_kind IS NULL) OR (reversal_kind = 'dispute_reversal'::text)) THEN (amount >= 0) ELSE (amount <= 0) END)
  constraint payments_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text, 'refunded'::text])))
  constraint payments_token_type_check CHECK (((token_type IS NULL) OR (token_type = ANY (ARRAY['network_token'::text, 'pan_via_proxy'::text, 'psp_token'::text]))))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_channel_transaction_id_key ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, channel, transaction_id) WHERE ((channel <> 'rail'::text) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX payments_created_at_id_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX payments_customer_id_created_at_id_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_customer_id_currency_id_key ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_customer_id_id_key ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX payments_destructive_run_id_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, destructive_run_id) WHERE (destructive_run_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX payments_invoice_id_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, invoice_id) WHERE (invoice_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_ledger_transfer_id_key ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, ledger_transfer_id) WHERE ((ledger_transfer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX payments_metadata_nmi_order_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, ((metadata ->> 'nmi_subscription_order_id'::text))) WHERE ((metadata ->> 'nmi_subscription_order_id'::text) IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX payments_metadata_stripe_invoice_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, ((metadata ->> 'stripe_invoice_id'::text))) WHERE ((metadata ->> 'stripe_invoice_id'::text) IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_order_id_charge_key ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, order_id) WHERE ((order_id IS NOT NULL) AND (refunded_payment_id IS NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['succeeded'::text, 'refunded'::text])) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX payments_order_id_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, order_id) WHERE (order_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX payments_pending_credit_refunds_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, refunded_payment_id) WHERE ((status = 'pending'::text) AND (amount < 0) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_pkey ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX payments_price_id_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, price_id)
  index CREATE INDEX payments_psp_id_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id) WHERE (psp_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_psp_id_transaction_id_key ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, transaction_id) WHERE ((psp_id IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX payments_purchased_at_merchant_purchased_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, purchased_at)
  index CREATE INDEX payments_purchased_at_purchased_at_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (purchased_at)
  index CREATE INDEX payments_rail_transaction_id_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, rail, transaction_id)
  index CREATE INDEX payments_refunded_payment_id_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, refunded_payment_id) WHERE (refunded_payment_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX payments_subscription_id_idx ON billing.payments USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE (subscription_id IS NOT NULL)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER payments_enqueue_settlement_event AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON billing.payments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.enqueue_payment_settlement_event()

table billing.price_key_movements
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column key text NOT NULL
  column price_id uuid NOT NULL
  column effective_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column archived boolean NOT NULL
  constraint price_key_movements_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint price_key_movements_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint price_key_movements_price_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, price_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  index CREATE INDEX price_key_movements_key_effective_at_idx ON billing.price_key_movements USING btree (merchant_id, key, effective_at DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX price_key_movements_pkey ON billing.price_key_movements USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX price_key_movements_price_id_idx ON billing.price_key_movements USING btree (merchant_id, price_id)

table billing.price_migrations
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column from_price_id uuid
  column from_product_id uuid
  column from_price_key text
  column to_price_id uuid NOT NULL
  column effective_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column fallback_policy text NOT NULL
  column subscriptions_matched integer NOT NULL
  column subscriptions_skipped integer NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column canceled_at timestamp with time zone
  constraint price_migrations_counts_check CHECK (((subscriptions_matched >= 0) AND ((subscriptions_skipped >= 0) AND (subscriptions_skipped <= subscriptions_matched))))
  constraint price_migrations_fallback_policy_check CHECK ((fallback_policy = ANY (ARRAY['keep_grandfathered'::text, 'cancel_at_period_end'::text])))
  constraint price_migrations_from_price_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, from_price_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint price_migrations_from_price_key_check CHECK ((from_price_key <> ''::text))
  constraint price_migrations_from_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, from_product_id) REFERENCES billing.products(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint price_migrations_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint price_migrations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint price_migrations_source_check CHECK ((((from_price_id IS NULL) = (from_price_key IS NOT NULL)) AND ((from_product_id IS NULL) = (from_price_key IS NULL))))
  constraint price_migrations_to_price_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, to_price_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  index CREATE INDEX price_migrations_created_at_id_idx ON billing.price_migrations USING btree (merchant_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX price_migrations_from_key_created_at_id_idx ON billing.price_migrations USING btree (merchant_id, from_product_id, from_price_key, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (from_price_key IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX price_migrations_from_price_id_idx ON billing.price_migrations USING btree (merchant_id, from_price_id) WHERE (from_price_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX price_migrations_pkey ON billing.price_migrations USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX price_migrations_to_price_id_idx ON billing.price_migrations USING btree (merchant_id, to_price_id)

table billing.price_psp_bindings
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column price_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column plan_id text
  column price_ref text
  column recurring_billing_option_id text
  column plan_pda text
  column flex_id text
  column configuration jsonb NOT NULL
  constraint price_psp_bindings_configuration_identity_check CHECK ((NOT (configuration ?| ARRAY['psp_id'::text, 'rail'::text, 'plan_id'::text, 'price_id'::text, 'recurring_billing_option_id'::text, 'plan_pda'::text, 'flex_id'::text])))
  constraint price_psp_bindings_configuration_object_check CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(configuration) = 'object'::text))
  constraint price_psp_bindings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, price_id, psp_id)
  constraint price_psp_bindings_plan_ref_nonempty_check CHECK (((plan_id IS NULL) OR (btrim(plan_id) <> ''::text)))
  constraint price_psp_bindings_price_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, price_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint price_psp_bindings_price_ref_nonempty_check CHECK (((price_ref IS NULL) OR (btrim(price_ref) <> ''::text)))
  constraint price_psp_bindings_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX price_psp_bindings_pkey ON billing.price_psp_bindings USING btree (merchant_id, price_id, psp_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX price_psp_bindings_psp_id_plan_id_key ON billing.price_psp_bindings USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, plan_id) WHERE (plan_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX price_psp_bindings_psp_id_plan_pda_key ON billing.price_psp_bindings USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, plan_pda) WHERE (plan_pda IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX price_psp_bindings_psp_id_price_ref_key ON billing.price_psp_bindings USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, price_ref) WHERE (price_ref IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX price_psp_bindings_psp_id_recurring_billing_option_id_key ON billing.price_psp_bindings USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, recurring_billing_option_id) WHERE (recurring_billing_option_id IS NOT NULL)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authored_binding BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.price_psp_bindings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.catalog_authored_write()

table billing.prices
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column product_id uuid NOT NULL
  column amount bigint NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column archived boolean NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column access_duration_hours integer
  column trial_unit_amount bigint
  column trial_duration_hours integer
  column key text NOT NULL
  column revision bigint NOT NULL
  column customer_amount jsonb
  column billing_interval_hours integer
  column quantity jsonb
  constraint prices_access_duration_positive_check CHECK (((access_duration_hours IS NULL) OR (access_duration_hours > 0)))
  constraint prices_amount_nonneg_check CHECK ((amount >= 0))
  constraint prices_billing_interval_positive_check CHECK (((billing_interval_hours IS NULL) OR (billing_interval_hours > 0)))
  constraint prices_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint prices_customer_amount_terms CHECK (((customer_amount IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(customer_amount) = 'object'::text) AND (amount = 0) AND (billing_interval_hours IS NULL) AND (access_duration_hours IS NULL) AND (trial_unit_amount IS NULL) AND (trial_duration_hours IS NULL) AND (customer_amount ? 'min_amount'::text) AND (customer_amount ? 'max_amount'::text) AND COALESCE((((customer_amount ->> 'min_amount'::text))::bigint > 0), false) AND COALESCE((((customer_amount ->> 'max_amount'::text))::bigint >= ((customer_amount ->> 'min_amount'::text))::bigint), false))))
  constraint prices_id_product_id_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, id, product_id)
  constraint prices_key_nonempty_check CHECK ((btrim(key) <> ''::text))
  constraint prices_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint prices_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint prices_product_amount_window_key UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (merchant_id, product_id, key, amount, currency, access_duration_hours, billing_interval_hours, trial_unit_amount, trial_duration_hours, customer_amount, quantity)
  constraint prices_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, product_id) REFERENCES billing.products(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint prices_product_key_revision_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, product_id, key, revision)
  constraint prices_quantity_terms CHECK (((quantity IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(quantity) = 'object'::text) AND (billing_interval_hours IS NOT NULL) AND (customer_amount IS NULL) AND (quantity ? 'min'::text) AND (quantity ? 'max'::text) AND COALESCE((((quantity ->> 'min'::text))::integer >= 1), false) AND COALESCE(((((quantity ->> 'max'::text))::integer >= ((quantity ->> 'min'::text))::integer) AND (((quantity ->> 'max'::text))::integer <= 10000)), false))))
  constraint prices_revision_nonnegative CHECK ((revision >= 0))
  constraint prices_trial_amount_nonneg_check CHECK (((trial_unit_amount IS NULL) OR (trial_unit_amount >= 0)))
  constraint prices_trial_both_or_neither_check CHECK (((trial_unit_amount IS NULL) = (trial_duration_hours IS NULL)))
  constraint prices_trial_needs_billing_interval_check CHECK (((trial_unit_amount IS NULL) OR (billing_interval_hours IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint prices_trial_period_positive_check CHECK (((trial_duration_hours IS NULL) OR (trial_duration_hours > 0)))
  index CREATE INDEX prices_created_at_id_idx ON billing.prices USING btree (merchant_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX prices_id_product_id_key ON billing.prices USING btree (merchant_id, id, product_id)
  index CREATE INDEX prices_key_idx ON billing.prices USING btree (merchant_id, product_id, key)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX prices_key_key ON billing.prices USING btree (merchant_id, product_id, key) WHERE (NOT archived)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX prices_pkey ON billing.prices USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX prices_product_amount_window_key ON billing.prices USING btree (merchant_id, product_id, key, amount, currency, access_duration_hours, billing_interval_hours, trial_unit_amount, trial_duration_hours, customer_amount, quantity) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX prices_product_key_revision_key ON billing.prices USING btree (merchant_id, product_id, key, revision)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authored_price BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.prices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.catalog_authored_write()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_price_retired AFTER UPDATE OF archived, key ON billing.prices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.catalog_price_retired()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_price_terms BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.prices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_billing_fact_columns('archived', 'updated_at')
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER no_price_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON billing.prices FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER price_revision BEFORE INSERT ON billing.prices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.assign_price_revision()

table billing.product_access
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column product_id uuid NOT NULL
  column grant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column source_type text NOT NULL
  column source_id text NOT NULL
  column payment_id uuid
  column starts_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column ends_at timestamp with time zone
  column revoked_at timestamp with time zone
  column revoke_reason text
  column deleted_at timestamp with time zone
  column destructive_run_id uuid
  column destructive_run_class text GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE WHEN (destructive_run_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'destructive'::text ELSE NULL::text END) STORED
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column quantity integer
  constraint product_access_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint product_access_destructive_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, destructive_run_id, destructive_run_class) REFERENCES billing.maintenance_runs(merchant_id, id, run_class) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint product_access_grant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, grant_id) REFERENCES billing.grants(merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  constraint product_access_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint product_access_payment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, payment_id) REFERENCES billing.payments(merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  constraint product_access_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint product_access_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, product_id) REFERENCES billing.products(merchant_id, id)
  constraint product_access_quantity_check CHECK (((quantity IS NULL) OR (quantity >= 1)))
  constraint product_access_revoke_fields_together_check CHECK (((revoked_at IS NULL) = (revoke_reason IS NULL)))
  constraint product_access_source_id_check CHECK (((octet_length(source_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(source_id) <= 255)))
  constraint product_access_source_type_check CHECK ((source_type = ANY (ARRAY['purchase'::text, 'subscription'::text, 'grace'::text, 'grant'::text])))
  constraint product_access_valid_time_window_check CHECK (((ends_at IS NULL) OR (starts_at < ends_at)))
  index CREATE INDEX product_access_closed_at_idx ON billing.product_access USING btree (merchant_id, LEAST(COALESCE(ends_at, 'infinity'::timestamp with time zone), COALESCE(revoked_at, 'infinity'::timestamp with time zone))) WHERE (((ends_at IS NOT NULL) OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL)) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX product_access_customer_created_idx ON billing.product_access USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX product_access_customer_idx ON billing.product_access USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, product_id) INCLUDE (starts_at, ends_at) WHERE ((revoked_at IS NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX product_access_destructive_run_id_idx ON billing.product_access USING btree (merchant_id, destructive_run_id) WHERE (destructive_run_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX product_access_grant_key ON billing.product_access USING btree (merchant_id, grant_id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX product_access_payment_idx ON billing.product_access USING btree (merchant_id, payment_id) WHERE (payment_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX product_access_pkey ON billing.product_access USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX product_access_product_idx ON billing.product_access USING btree (merchant_id, product_id, customer_id) INCLUDE (starts_at, ends_at) WHERE ((revoked_at IS NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX product_access_source_idx ON billing.product_access USING btree (merchant_id, source_type, source_id)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER product_access_release_ownership_claims AFTER UPDATE OF revoked_at, deleted_at ON billing.product_access FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.release_ended_ownership_claims()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER product_access_step_version_delete AFTER DELETE ON billing.product_access REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS changed FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.step_access_version()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER product_access_step_version_insert AFTER INSERT ON billing.product_access REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS changed FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.step_access_version()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER product_access_step_version_update AFTER UPDATE ON billing.product_access REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS changed FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.step_access_version()

table billing.product_archive_operations
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column idempotency_key text NOT NULL
  column request_sha256 bytea NOT NULL
  column product_id uuid NOT NULL
  column purchase_action text NOT NULL
  column purchase_window_starts_at timestamp with time zone
  column reason text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint product_archive_operations_idempotency_key_check CHECK (((length(idempotency_key) >= 1) AND (length(idempotency_key) <= 255)))
  constraint product_archive_operations_idempotency_key_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, idempotency_key)
  constraint product_archive_operations_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint product_archive_operations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint product_archive_operations_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, product_id) REFERENCES billing.products(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint product_archive_operations_purchase_action_check CHECK ((purchase_action = ANY (ARRAY['none'::text, 'refund'::text, 'review'::text])))
  constraint product_archive_operations_purchase_window_check CHECK (((purchase_action = 'none'::text) = (purchase_window_starts_at IS NULL)))
  constraint product_archive_operations_reason_check CHECK (((length(reason) >= 1) AND (length(reason) <= 500)))
  constraint product_archive_operations_request_sha256_check CHECK ((octet_length(request_sha256) = 32))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX product_archive_operations_idempotency_key_key ON billing.product_archive_operations USING btree (merchant_id, idempotency_key)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX product_archive_operations_pkey ON billing.product_archive_operations USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX product_archive_operations_product_id_idx ON billing.product_archive_operations USING btree (merchant_id, product_id)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_product_archive_operation BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.product_archive_operations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_product_archive_operation()

table billing.product_entitlements
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column product_id uuid NOT NULL
  column entitlement text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
  column added_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column removed_at timestamp with time zone
  column added_by text NOT NULL
  column removed_by text
  constraint product_entitlements_added_by_check CHECK (((octet_length(added_by) >= 1) AND (octet_length(added_by) <= 255)))
  constraint product_entitlements_entitlement_check CHECK ((((octet_length(entitlement) >= 1) AND (octet_length(entitlement) <= 256)) AND (btrim(entitlement) <> ''::text)))
  constraint product_entitlements_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint product_entitlements_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint product_entitlements_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, product_id) REFERENCES billing.products(merchant_id, id)
  constraint product_entitlements_removed_by_check CHECK (((removed_by IS NULL) OR ((octet_length(removed_by) >= 1) AND (octet_length(removed_by) <= 255))))
  constraint product_entitlements_removed_check CHECK (((removed_at IS NULL) = (removed_by IS NULL)))
  constraint product_entitlements_window_check CHECK (((removed_at IS NULL) OR (removed_at >= added_at)))
  index CREATE INDEX product_entitlements_entitlement_idx ON billing.product_entitlements USING btree (merchant_id, entitlement) INCLUDE (product_id, added_at, removed_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX product_entitlements_live_key ON billing.product_entitlements USING btree (merchant_id, product_id, entitlement) WHERE (removed_at IS NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX product_entitlements_pkey ON billing.product_entitlements USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX product_entitlements_product_idx ON billing.product_entitlements USING btree (merchant_id, product_id, entitlement, added_at) INCLUDE (removed_at)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authored_entitlements_insert AFTER INSERT ON billing.product_entitlements REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS changed FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.catalog_authored_entitlements()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authored_entitlements_update AFTER UPDATE ON billing.product_entitlements REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS changed FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.catalog_authored_entitlements()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_product_entitlement_history BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.product_entitlements FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_product_entitlement_history()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_product_entitlement_history_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON billing.product_entitlements FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER product_entitlements_step_generation_insert AFTER INSERT ON billing.product_entitlements REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS changed FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.step_entitlement_generation()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER product_entitlements_step_generation_update AFTER UPDATE ON billing.product_entitlements REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS changed FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.step_entitlement_generation()

table billing.products
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column key text NOT NULL
  column display_name text NOT NULL
  column description text
  column tier_group text
  column tier_rank integer NOT NULL
  column archived boolean NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column credit_grant jsonb
  column ownership text
  constraint products_credit_grant_object CHECK (((credit_grant IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(credit_grant) = 'object'::text) AND COALESCE(((credit_grant ->> 'currency'::text) ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text), false) AND COALESCE(((((credit_grant ->> 'expires_after_days'::text))::integer >= 1) AND (((credit_grant ->> 'expires_after_days'::text))::integer <= 36500)), false) AND ((COALESCE((((credit_grant ->> 'amount'::text))::bigint > 0), false) AND (NOT COALESCE(((credit_grant ->> 'from_payment'::text))::boolean, false))) OR ((NOT (credit_grant ? 'amount'::text)) AND COALESCE(((credit_grant ->> 'from_payment'::text))::boolean, false))))))
  constraint products_key_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, key)
  constraint products_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint products_ownership_check CHECK ((ownership = ANY (ARRAY['unique'::text, 'consumable'::text, 'extend'::text])))
  constraint products_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint products_revision_check CHECK ((revision >= 0))
  constraint products_tier_group_check CHECK (((char_length(tier_group) >= 1) AND (char_length(tier_group) <= 100)))
  index CREATE INDEX products_archived_idx ON billing.products USING btree (archived)
  index CREATE INDEX products_created_at_id_idx ON billing.products USING btree (merchant_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX products_key_idx ON billing.products USING btree (key)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX products_key_key ON billing.products USING btree (merchant_id, key)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX products_pkey ON billing.products USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX products_tier_group_idx ON billing.products USING btree (tier_group) WHERE (tier_group IS NOT NULL)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authored_product BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.catalog_authored_write()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_product_offer_state AFTER UPDATE OF archived ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.catalog_product_offer_state()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_product_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_product_identity()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER no_product_delete BEFORE DELETE ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER no_product_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON billing.products FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER product_revision BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.assign_product_revision()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_guard_tier_group BEFORE UPDATE OF tier_group ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.products_guard_tier_group()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_propagate_tier_group AFTER UPDATE OF tier_group ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.products_propagate_tier_group()

table billing.provider_intents
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column intent_type text NOT NULL
  column subscription_id uuid
  column payment_id uuid
  column price_id uuid
  column payload jsonb
  column idempotency_key text NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column next_attempt_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column lease_expires_at timestamp with time zone
  column origin text NOT NULL
  column origin_reason text
  column actor text
  column last_failure_reason text
  column expires_at timestamp with time zone
  column result_evidence jsonb
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column executed_at timestamp with time zone
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column psp_id uuid
  column destructive_run_id uuid
  column destructive_run_class text GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE WHEN (destructive_run_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'destructive'::text ELSE NULL::text END) STORED
  column custodian_id uuid
  column subject text
  column credential text
  constraint provider_intents_addressed_check CHECK (((psp_id IS NOT NULL) OR (custodian_id IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint provider_intents_credential_check CHECK ((credential <> ''::text))
  constraint provider_intents_custodian_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, custodian_id) REFERENCES billing.custodians(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_intents_destructive_run_id_destructive_run_class_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, destructive_run_id, destructive_run_class) REFERENCES billing.maintenance_runs(merchant_id, id, run_class) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_intents_executed_check CHECK (((status <> 'succeeded'::text) OR (executed_at IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint provider_intents_idempotency_key_check CHECK (((octet_length(idempotency_key) >= 1) AND (octet_length(idempotency_key) <= 512)))
  constraint provider_intents_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_intents_origin_check CHECK ((origin = ANY (ARRAY['user'::text, 'admin'::text, 'system'::text])))
  constraint provider_intents_payment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, payment_id) REFERENCES billing.payments(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (payment_id)
  constraint provider_intents_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint provider_intents_price_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, price_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (price_id)
  constraint provider_intents_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_intents_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_flight'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'unknown_needs_verify'::text, 'failed_retryable'::text, 'failed_terminal'::text, 'superseded'::text, 'expired'::text])))
  constraint provider_intents_subject_check CHECK ((subject <> ''::text))
  constraint provider_intents_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (subscription_id)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_actor_created_at_intent_type_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (actor, created_at, intent_type) WHERE (origin = ANY (ARRAY['user'::text, 'admin'::text]))
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_checkout_attempt_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, ((payload ->> 'checkout_attempt_id'::text))) WHERE (payload ? 'checkout_attempt_id'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_custodian_method_delete_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, custodian_id, (((payload -> 'instrument'::text) ->> 'rail_method_ref'::text))) WHERE (intent_type = 'hyperswitch_method_delete'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_destructive_run_id_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, destructive_run_id) WHERE (destructive_run_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_idempotency_key_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, idempotency_key)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_initial_membership_history_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, (((payload -> 'terms'::text) ->> 'subscription_id'::text))) WHERE ((intent_type = 'initial_membership'::text) AND (status = 'succeeded'::text))
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_native_vault_delete_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, ((payload ->> 'rail_customer_ref'::text))) WHERE (intent_type = 'nmi_vault_delete'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_next_attempt_at_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (next_attempt_at) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_flight'::text, 'failed_retryable'::text, 'unknown_needs_verify'::text]))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_obligation_unreleased_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, ((payload ->> 'order_reference'::text))) WHERE ((intent_type = ANY (ARRAY['subscription_collection'::text, 'manual_rebill'::text])) AND (status <> ALL (ARRAY['failed_terminal'::text, 'superseded'::text, 'expired'::text])))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_open_subscription_collection_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE ((intent_type = 'subscription_collection'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_flight'::text, 'unknown_needs_verify'::text, 'failed_retryable'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_origin_created_at_intent_type_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, origin, created_at, intent_type)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_pkey ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_psp_id_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id) WHERE (psp_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_subscription_collection_slot_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, ((payload ->> 'previous_period_end'::text)), ((payload ->> 'attempt'::text))) WHERE (intent_type = 'subscription_collection'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_subscription_id_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE (subscription_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_subscription_id_open_manual_rebill_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE ((intent_type = 'manual_rebill'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_flight'::text, 'unknown_needs_verify'::text, 'failed_retryable'::text])))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_subscription_id_tier_change_subscription_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE ((intent_type = ANY (ARRAY['nmi_upgrade'::text, 'stripe_tier_change'::text, 'initial_membership'::text])) AND (subscription_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_flight'::text, 'unknown_needs_verify'::text, 'failed_retryable'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_updated_at_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, updated_at) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['succeeded'::text, 'failed_terminal'::text, 'superseded'::text, 'expired'::text])) AND (destructive_run_id IS NULL) AND (intent_type = ANY (ARRAY['nmi_delete_subscription'::text, 'stripe_cancel_subscription'::text, 'ccbill_cancel_subscription'::text, 'nmi_payment_method_update'::text, 'nmi_payment_source_update'::text, 'nmi_card_vault'::text, 'network_token'::text, 'stripe_archive_price'::text, 'stripe_archive_product'::text, 'solana_sunset_plan'::text, 'bt_account_updater_batch'::text])))

table billing.provider_mutation_logs
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid
  column provider_intent_id uuid
  column intent_type text
  column idempotency_key text
  column attempt integer NOT NULL
  column phase text NOT NULL
  column reason text
  column evidence jsonb
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column custodian_id uuid
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_addressed_check CHECK (((psp_id IS NOT NULL) OR (custodian_id IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_custodian_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, custodian_id) REFERENCES billing.custodians(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_phase_check CHECK ((phase = ANY (ARRAY['attempting'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'parked'::text])))
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_provider_intent_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, provider_intent_id) REFERENCES billing.provider_intents(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (provider_intent_id)
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_created_at_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, created_at DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_custodian_id_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, custodian_id) WHERE (custodian_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_pkey ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_provider_intent_id_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, provider_intent_id) WHERE (provider_intent_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_psp_id_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id) WHERE (psp_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_rail_phase_created_at_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (rail, phase, created_at DESC)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_provider_mutation_log_content BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.provider_mutation_logs FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((NOT ((new.provider_intent_id IS NULL) AND ((to_jsonb(new.*) - 'provider_intent_id'::text) = (to_jsonb(old.*) - 'provider_intent_id'::text))))) EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()

table billing.provisioning_tokens
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column name text NOT NULL
  column declared boolean NOT NULL
  column token_sha256 bytea NOT NULL
  column last_used_at timestamp with time zone
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint provisioning_tokens_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provisioning_tokens_name_check CHECK (((name = btrim(name)) AND (name <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(name) <= 128)))
  constraint provisioning_tokens_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint provisioning_tokens_token_sha256_check CHECK ((octet_length(token_sha256) = 32))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provisioning_tokens_declared_key ON billing.provisioning_tokens USING btree (merchant_id) WHERE declared
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provisioning_tokens_pkey ON billing.provisioning_tokens USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provisioning_tokens_token_sha256_key ON billing.provisioning_tokens USING btree (token_sha256)

table billing.psp_customers
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column remote_customer_ref text NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint psp_customers_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
